t=d.get('tool_input',{})
s=t.get('content') or t.get('new_string') or ''
b=[L.strip() for L in s.splitlines() if re.search(r'§ ?8|section 8',L.lower()) and 'raid-composition-guide' not in L.lower() and 'target spec ranges' not in L.lower()]
if b:
 sys.stderr.write('Blocked: call it the target spec ranges (canonical name), not a bare §8 / Section 8 label. CLAUDE.md Communication conventions: a bare §8 is allowed only as a location pointer in a cross-reference naming reference/raid-composition-guide.md on the same line. Offending: '+' | '.join(b))
 sys.exit(2)"
